verdict.rationale: Versioning automation assets such as collections, scripts and test runs is a fair question for an API client, so the axis applies. The pack documents no version history, change review or rollback for collections or scripts. Enterprise audit logs are an adjacent control, and a community feature request asking for Git sync of collections suggests native versioning is absent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
